findings.text: Three ordinary external gears mesh in a row. Gear 1 turns clockwise. What direction does Gear 3 turn?
findings.problem: number in prose outside inline math

findings.text: Gear 1 clockwise → Gear 2 counter-clockwise → Gear 3 clockwise. Gear 3 turns **clockwise**.
findings.problem: number in prose outside inline math

findings.text: Five external gears mesh in a row. Gear 1 turns counter-clockwise. Gear 5 is four meshes away, so the direction has reversed an even number of times. Gear 5 turns **counter-clockwise**.

findings.text: A 10-tooth external gear meshes with a 30-tooth external gear. If the 10-tooth gear completes 6 rotations, how many rotations does the 30-tooth gear complete?
findings.problem: number in prose outside inline math

findings.text: The larger gear makes **2 rotations**, in the opposite direction.
